name: 24haowan-space
description: 24haowan Space (space.24haowan.com): an agent-native B2B pre-sales proposal platform with 21 tools. Publish a finished proposal (PDF / PPTX / HTML deck / Markdown) as a client-specific WeChat-readable link, read back which pages the client viewed and for how long, collect their feedback, log meeting notes against the proposal, and push new versions that update the same link. Requires WeChat-scan login (OAuth).

display.name: 24好玩 · 方案空间
